name: fuse-beads-tool
description: 拼豆（Perler / Fuse Beads）图案制作工具前端

scripts.test: node scripts/check-meta.mjs && node tests/frontend_logic_test.mjs && node tests/dom_ui_test.mjs && node tests/dom_state_test.mjs && node tests/dom_editor_test.mjs && node tests/dom_contract_test.mjs && node tests/constants_sync_test.mjs && node tests/els_contract_test.mjs
scripts.test:playwright: npm run test:ui && npm run test:render && npm run test:auth
scripts.test:coverage:backend: node scripts/run-python.mjs -m coverage run --source=app,bead tests/smoke_test.py && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m coverage run -a --source=app,bead tests/watermark_test.py && node scripts/run-python.mjs -m coverage report -m
scripts.test:coverage: npm run test:coverage:frontend && npm run test:coverage:backend
scripts.test:backend: node scripts/run-python.mjs tests/smoke_test.py && node scripts/run-python.mjs tests/watermark_test.py
scripts.test:all: npm test && npm run test:backend && npm run test:playwright
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm run lint:backend && npm run typecheck:backend && npm test
